# Effects and painting

[Catalog contents](README.md) · [日本語](../ja/effects.md) · [Searchable site](https://bankai-tensei.github.io/gowaku/catalog/effects/)

Widgets that change how their child looks, and the ones that paint on their own. None changes the layout.

> The lower-case functions in the examples (`themed`, `colored`, `tile`, and shapes such as `squareIcon`) are small helpers in [internal/catalog/helpers.go](../../../internal/catalog/helpers.go); `themed` is a `basic.Builder` that reads `basic.ThemeOf(ctx)`. `core.Widget` and `core.BuildContext` in the examples are the same types as `gowaku.Widget` and `gowaku.BuildContext`.

## basic.Opacity

Paints its child with a uniform transparency. At 0 the pointer, the focus and assistive technology skip it.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic)

  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../img/basic-opacity-dark.png">
  <img src="../img/basic-opacity-light.png" alt="basic.Opacity" width="356">
</picture>

```go
accent := geom.Hex(0x2f5fd0)
return basic.Row{Size: layout.MainMin, Spacing: theme.Space12, Children: []core.Widget{
	swatch("1.0", accent),
	basic.Opacity{Opacity: 0.6, Child: swatch("0.6", accent)},
	basic.Opacity{Opacity: 0.3, Child: swatch("0.3", accent)},
}}
```

## basic.Blend

Combines its child as one picture with what is below, as mix-blend-mode does in CSS.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic)

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../img/basic-blend-dark.png">
  <img src="../img/basic-blend-light.png" alt="basic.Blend" width="312">
</picture>

```go
backdrop := basic.Container{Width: 280, Height: 80, Radius: 12, Gradient: &paint.Gradient{
	End: geom.Offset{X: 280}, StartColor: geom.Hex(0xfde047), EndColor: geom.Hex(0x10b981),
}}
return basic.Stack{Children: []core.Widget{
	backdrop,
	basic.Positioned{Left: 10, Child: rings()},
	basic.Positioned{Left: 150, Child: basic.Blend{Mode: paint.BlendMultiply, Child: rings()}},
}}
```

## basic.ClipRRect

Cuts what its child paints to its box; `ClipRRect` rounds the corners, to the theme's card corners when Radius is 0. The pointer reaches the child only inside the cut shape.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic)

## control.CustomPaint

Paints with a `layout.Painter`, for charts, meters and other shapes no widget offers.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/control`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/control)

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../img/control-custompaint-dark.png">
  <img src="../img/control-custompaint-light.png" alt="control.CustomPaint" width="274">
</picture>

```go
control.CustomPaint{Width: 240, Height: 100, Painter: layout.PainterFunc(func(cv *paint.Canvas, sz geom.Size) {
	bars := []float32{0.4, 0.7, 0.5, 0.9, 0.6, 0.8}
	w := sz.W / float32(len(bars))
	for i, v := range bars {
		r := geom.Rect{X: float32(i)*w + 4, Y: sz.H * (1 - v), W: w - 8, H: sz.H * v}
		cv.DrawRRect(geom.RRectAll(r, 4), paint.Paint{Color: geom.Hex(0x2f5fd0).WithAlpha(0.4 + v*0.6)})
	}
	var line paint.Path
	line.MoveTo(0, sz.H*0.7)
	line.QuadTo(sz.W/2, 0, sz.W, sz.H*0.4)
	cv.DrawPath(&line, paint.Paint{Stroke: &paint.Stroke{Width: 2, Color: geom.Hex(0xd04a2f)}})
})}
```

API: [`control.CustomPaint`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/control#CustomPaint)

## basic.RepaintBoundary

Keeps the picture of its child apart, so a change on one side does not repaint the other.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic)

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../img/basic-repaintboundary-dark.png">
  <img src="../img/basic-repaintboundary-light.png" alt="basic.RepaintBoundary" width="232">
</picture>

```go
// A meter that changes on every frame keeps its repaints to itself.
return basic.RepaintBoundary{Child: basic.SizedBox{Width: 200, Child: control.ProgressBar{Value: 0.45, Label: "Level"}}}
```

## interact.FocusRing

Draws the pale 3px focus ring of the standard controls, for controls of your own.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../img/interact-focusring-dark.png">
  <img src="../img/interact-focusring-light.png" alt="interact.FocusRing" width="178">
</picture>

```go
themed(func(th *theme.Theme) core.Widget {
	return interact.FocusRing{Visible: true, Radius: th.Radius.Control, Child: basic.Container{
		Width: 140, Height: 36, Radius: th.Radius.Control, Color: th.Color.AccentTint,
		Child: basic.Center{Child: basic.Text{Content: "Focus ring", Style: colored(th.Text.Control, th.Color.AccentInk)}},
	}}
})
```

API: [`interact.FocusRing`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#FocusRing)
